Beta ver.1.0
Testing,maybe got bugs.

This is a Zombie Escape map from CSGO,I port and half remake it by myself.
Map only contain Level 1,Level! and Nightmare mode.
yet,I might update more level in future.lol

The difference with CSGO version is:
i remove all the item and sanity system(say thanks to Valve).
But added 3 new NPC will randomly spawn in every new round.
remove laser ending for LEVEL! minigame.

More information about NPC and Nightmare mode,Check in Office at the begining room.

i hope u enjoy the map.
rate it if u like it :)
because im maybe planning to make other version of this map.
